name: c3-x2
instruction: Follow the career-rules Skill and reread it whenever its rules are not in view. Decide stories only with its Story decisions and quarterly phases only with its quarterly list. Turn loop: answer each situation with ONE reply whose tool_calls array holds exactly two calls: [take_action(session_id, choice, notes), observe(session_id)]. Start the pattern on the opening Continue screen and keep it to the last month. Decide silently if you can; if you write anything, keep it to one short line and still send both calls in that same reply. The runner executes them in order and returns both results, so the observe already shows the next situation. Never send take_action alone and never observe in a reply of its own. Never end a reply with text only: until the run is over, every reply carries its tool calls, so put the decision in the take_action call, not in prose. In a quarterly phase, first quarter of the run: the Energy actions and observe, then the main action and observe, noting both menus' numbers; from the second quarter on, one reply with one take_action per Energy action, one for the main action, then observe. In every story, drop options that may bury a problem (private, anonymous, partial, later, hidden, skipping work to save time). In the two months before a review, keep Network and Output at their best this level and repair any loss at once; in the month before a review (Review in 1), never pick an option that may lower Skill, Network or Output when another avoids it (saying no, correcting someone in front of others or putting your work next to a colleague's costs Network even when polite; coaching, formal write-ups and other people's meetings cost Output); while the HR remark is friendly or quiet this comes before avoiding a mild risk. From level 4 on, every quarterly phase goes to Skill: Skill learning while Health allows, then one point on Network or Output, and Apply for rotation as the main action, unless the HR remark or a low stat says otherwise. Stalled start (still at your starting level after two reviews): until the next review, drop every option that may add hidden risk in any month (private, partial, phased, postponed or temporary fixes too), prefer the option that documents, reports or follows the process, keep Skill, Network and Output at their Best, and every quarter Defuse legacy risk first. While the HR remark is friendly or quiet, no risky option has been chosen this month and there has been no blow-up, a mild risk is acceptable whenever it grows Skill, Network or Output more than any safe option: take the largest total gain. Every note is one line: the status line and at most one short reason.
